items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: First it was Desveen and he gave the band up and then Joe Phillips taking the band.

ctx.x: Well, Joe Phillips now, does he still have a band?

No. William Houston had taken the band in charge after that. First it was Desveen and he gave the band up and then Joe Phillips taking the band. Then the next thing I knew William Houston, well he had taken it. That's the original band up. Yeah. Of course they've had quite a few, you know, younger musicians in it to date. But some of the fellas who started out with Sidney and Desveen, they still play with Houston. Oh, yeah. Some of them went with Larry, some of the old times.

I wanted to stop playing music. He didn't want me to stop. I was going to resign. He said, what are you going to stop? All the girls told me I'm going to get into church. Stop playing music and go to John's church. You can't do both, huh? I don't know. My manager was doing it. He's going to belong to that church over there. The manager of the band is belonging to that church. Remember when he comes up to that night?
